items.title: Meta raises $15 billion in five-part US bond sale
items.summary: Meta is raising $15 billion through five US-dollar bond tranches to help fund AI infrastructure. Disclosed tranches include $3.25 billion due in 2031 at a 5.85% coupon and $3.25 billion due in 2033 at 6.25%.
items.context: Reuters links the borrowing to data-centre and computing expansion. The stated coupons are contractual interest rates on those tranches, not their market yields or a forecast return.

items.context: A weaker real can lift import prices, while uncertainty over public finances can keep financing expensive. The article describes expectations ahead of the policy meeting, not its outcome; the government’s fiscal plans remain central to the outlook.
